title: Among Us!
notes:
ALL RISE!

Update to v18.0.0 so you can play as our brand new Crewmate role - the Judge!
Overrule Ability: Choose a Crewmate to eject no matter who's been voted for. Choose wisely - if they aren't the Impostor you get ejected instead! Complete tasks to enable your ability during meetings.
Use the new Match Info Guide so you can keep track of players, roles, and match settings during a game.
The Detective's Interrogate ability now has a cooldown after Emergency Meetings.

notes:

L’hiver sera un jour réchauffé par le feu ! Une fois la Chaudière au Niv. 1 Cristal Ardent, ta Ville entrera officiellement dans l’« Ère du Cristal Ardent ».
